name: Codiv
description: Codiv offers a finite text-generation allowance during its public experiment.
overview: Codiv offers 10 million text-generation tokens per account and a separate 100 million System One token allowance during its free public experiment, with no card required and 60 requests per minute per key. The text-generation allowance is a finite per-account grant, not a recurring quota. The service and experiment may change.
notes: Use diffusiongemma-26b on /v1/chat/completions. The 10M allowance is not described as renewing.
